d: Ice is frozen water that is hard, clear, and extremely cold.
An idea is a plan, thought, or suggestion that you form in your mind.
If something is ideal, it is perfect and exactly right for a particular purpose.
If you identify someone, you recognize them and say who they are.
Your identity is exactly who you are and what makes you different from others.
An idiom is a phrase where the meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words.
An idiot is an insulting word for someone who behaves in a very stupid way.
If someone is idle, they are not doing any work and have nothing to do.
You use if to introduce a condition that must happen before something else can happen.
If you ignore someone, you deliberately pay no attention to them.
If you are ill, you are suffering from a sickness or disease.
If something is illegal, the law strictly says that you are not allowed to do it.
An illness is a medical condition where you feel sick or your body is unhealthy.
An illusion is a false idea or a visual trick that makes you see something that is not there.
If you illustrate a book, you draw pictures to go with the text.
An image is a picture, photograph, or a mental picture of something in your mind.
Your imagination is your ability to form pictures and new ideas in your mind.
If you imagine something, you close your eyes and think about what it would be like.
If an action is immediate, it happens right away without any delay.
If you do something immediately, you do it instantly without waiting at all.
An immigrant is a person who has come to a new country in order to live there permanently.
If you are immune to a disease, your body is protected and you cannot catch it.
An impact is a sudden, powerful effect that an event has on a situation or person.
If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed because you have to wait for something.
If you imply something, you suggest that it is true without saying it directly.
If a country imports goods, it buys them from another country and brings them in.
Importance is the quality of being very significant, necessary, or valuable.
If something is important, it has a big effect on people's lives or decisions.
If you impose a rule, you use your authority to force people to accept it.
If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot ever happen.
If you impress someone, you make them feel great admiration and respect for you.
Your impression of a person is what you think they are like after meeting them briefly.
If something is impressive, it is so good, large, or skillful that you admire it greatly.
If you improve something, you make it better than it was before.
An improvement is a positive change that makes something better.
You use in to show that someone or something is inside a container or place.
An incident is an unusual, important, or dangerous event that happens suddenly.
If a group includes something, it contains that thing as one of its parts.
You use including to introduce a specific item that is part of a larger group.
Your income is the money you regularly earn from your job or investments.
If you incorporate an idea, you carefully include it as part of a larger plan.
If you increase something, you make it larger in number, amount, or level.
You use indeed to emphasize a statement or confirm that something is definitely true.
If you are independent, you do not need help or money from anyone else.
An index is an alphabetical list at the back of a book showing where to find subjects.
If you indicate something, you point it out or show that it is true.
An indication is a sign or a clue that shows something is happening or exists.
An individual is one single person, considered separately from the rest of a group.
Industrial means relating to the large factories and companies in a town or country.
An industry is the group of businesses that produce one particular type of goods or service.
If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and absolutely impossible to avoid.
An infant is a formal word for a baby or a very young child.
An infection is a disease caused by germs or bacteria entering your body.
Influence is the power to change how someone behaves or how a situation develops.
If you inform someone, you officially tell them facts or details about a situation.
If something is informal, it is relaxed and friendly rather than strict and official.
Information is facts and details that you learn about a particular subject.
An ingredient is one of the specific food items you mix together to cook a meal.
You use initial to describe something that happens at the very beginning of a process.
If something happens initially, it happens at first, before things later change.
An initiative is an important new plan designed to solve a problem or improve a situation.
If you injure yourself, you accidentally hurt your body, causing physical damage.
An injury is the physical damage or hurt done to a person's body.
The inner parts of something are the parts that are inside or near the center.
If someone is innocent, they did not commit the crime they are accused of.
An inquiry is an official process to discover the facts about an event or problem.
An insect is a small animal with six legs, like a bee, ant, or fly.
If you are inside a place, you are enclosed within its walls or boundaries.
An insight is a deep, clear understanding of a complicated problem or situation.
If you insist on something, you say very strongly that it must happen.
If you inspect something, you examine it very carefully to make sure it is perfect.
An inspector is an official whose job is to check that rules are being followed.
If you install equipment or software, you put it into position so it is ready to use.
An instance is one specific example or occurrence of a situation or event.
If an event is instant, it happens immediately without any delay at all.
You use instead to say that one thing is chosen as a replacement for another.
An instinct is a natural feeling that makes you behave a certain way without thinking.
An institution is a large, important organization like a university, bank, or hospital.
An instruction is a clear order or explanation telling you how to do something.
An instrument is an object like a piano or guitar used for making music.
If you insult someone, you say something very rude that hurts their feelings.
Insurance is an agreement where you pay a company, and they pay for future damage or medical care.
If someone is intelligent, they are very smart and quick to learn new things.
If you intend to do something, you have decided that you are going to do it.
If a feeling or action is intense, it is very strong, extreme, and powerful.
Your intention is the plan or purpose that you have securely decided in your mind.
Interest is the desire you feel to learn more about a fascinating subject.
If something is interesting, it easily holds your attention because it is unusual or exciting.
Internal means happening inside a person's body or within a specific country or organization.
International means involving two or more different countries from around the world.
The internet is the global computer network that allows people to share information electronically.
If you interrupt someone, you suddenly speak while they are talking, causing them to stop.
An interview is a formal meeting where someone asks you questions to see if you qualify for a job.
If you introduce two people, you tell them each other's names so they can meet.
If you invent something, you are the very first person to design and create it.
If you invest money, you give it to a business hoping to make a profit later.
If two people are intimate, they have a very close, private, and loving relationship.
If you intimate something, you hint at it or suggest it indirectly without saying it clearly.
An invalid is someone who needs to be cared for because they have a chronic illness or injury.
If a document or argument is invalid, it is not legally accepted or logically correct.
